definitions.explanation: A secondary or supplementary title that appears alongside the main title of a book, article, film, or other work. Provides additional context or clarification for the main title. Not to be confused with movie subtitles ({字幕|じまく}).

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}の{副題|ふくだい}は{何|なん}ですか。
examples.english: What is the subtitle of this book?

examples.japanese: {論文|ろんぶん}には{副題|ふくだい}を{付|つ}けることが{多|おお}い。
{映画|えいが}の{副題|ふくだい}が{内容|ないよう}をよく{表|あらわ}している。
examples.english: The film's subtitle captures its content well.

notes:
Refers to a secondary title of a work (like a book's subtitle after a colon), not to movie/TV subtitles displayed on screen. For on-screen subtitles, use {字幕|じまく}.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{副題|ふくだい}を{付|つ}ける (to add a subtitle)
・〜という{副題|ふくだい} (a subtitle that says ~)
・{副題|ふくだい}のない (without a subtitle)
